subject: history
concept: Applying world geography knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student plans an imaginary trip to a chosen world region, using map and climate knowledge to prepare
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their trip plan on a simple map
exercise.abstract: Student explains their trip choices in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: trip plan reflects accurate location and climate reasoning for the chosen region
misconception_flags: trip plan includes climate or location details inconsistent with the actual chosen region

interest_binding: region generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
